final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN ('Office building', 'Commercial unit')
  AND surface_area >= 250
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 7.5
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
